_comment: Archetype rules, derived from the card signatures mined out of the fetched
decklists (scripts/mine_archetypes.py), not from a remembered metagame.
Rules are evaluated in ascending `priority`, first match wins, so the
specific combo decks are tested before the broad ones. That ordering is
what keeps decks with shared pieces apart: Broodscale before Eldrazi
(Broodscale lists also run Emrakul and Sowing Mycospawn), Goryo's before
Blink (both run Ephemerate and Prismatic Ending), Prowess before Burn.
`parent` groups variants into a family for the dashboard's merge toggle.
Edit freely -- this file is the classifier.
